relationship_note: Repeated views do not represent additional animals. No cross-publication pooling; source labels preserved.
scale_note: No recoverable physical calibration assigned; retain pixels only where geometry is defensible.

rois.label: SI (historical outline)
rois.boundary_note: Unscaled historical SI map redrawn from Bohringer and Rowe (1977). Only drawing pixels are measured. Text warns that early SI may include fields now called SI, R and PV; this is not a modern specimen-level total SI area. Body icons that contact the enclosing stroke are retained inside the historical SI envelope; their outlines are not field borders.
rois.tracing_method: Source closed-cell union and dense outer contour; source-reviewed. Internal glyph holes retained within anatomical envelope.

unmeasured.label: SI absolute area
unmeasured.reason: No physical scale or specimen identity is supplied for this historical redrawing. Its pixel geometry is not entered into biological area summaries.

review_note: Dense tracing on 4 pixels/PDF point source rendering. Anatomical interpretation provisional; hide overlay in the precision review to inspect the printed stroke.
